explain.en: Models and datasets downloaded by Hugging Face libraries such as transformers and diffusers. They download again when a program needs them; offline use fails until then. Models can share files, so Hoardless only shows Hugging Face's own command, which removes one model at a time.
explain.zh: transformers、diffusers 等 Hugging Face 库下载的模型和数据集。程序需要时会重新下载，下载完之前离线用不了。不同模型之间会共用文件，所以这里只给出 Hugging Face 自带的命令，一次删一个模型。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 4.1G, 11 model folders. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: Never target ~/.cache/huggingface as a whole: it holds login tokens (token, stored_tokens). Xet files are stored once in a shared hub/blobs store that repos link into (on by default; HF_HUB_DISABLE_SHARED_BLOBS=1 turns it off, see the Shared blobs across repos section of the manage-cache guide), so removing folders by hand can break other models: command_only.
